purpose: Preserve the two approved 2D premium hero identities as immutable reference art. This manifest documents existing source; it changes no game rendering.

renderer_status.premium_uiji: Original 2D 36-cell (3 modes x 12 frames) motion atlas. No Work skeletal renderer loaded.
renderer_status.premium_useoi: Original 2D hero pictures with 3-layer cape motion and dedicated left/right wall-kick art. No Work skeletal renderer loaded.
renderer_status.legacy_experiments: Work Rigby2D, rig-v3, keypose-live and starter-kit are not imported by current index.html.

order: 무료 초보 모험자 (남녀 외형을 먼저 완성)
next_character_workflow.first_target: 초보 모험자, 낡았지만 깔끔한 옷: 모자 없음, 크림 티셔츠, 검정/회색 반바지, 파란 슬리퍼, 베이지 보자기 망토
output_requirements: Draw a self-contained complete character for every key motion; do NOT collage an original face on a vector stick-puppet body.
Use frozen original character identity as visual comparison for face, hair, expression and proportions. Reject drift.
Start with a full neutral-fall illustration, then redraw matching fully clothed poses for folded acceleration and left/right wall jumps.
Use multiple coherent sprite frames per action and original gameplay cadence; swap the entire full-body sprite by character ID.
No new Work/Rigby2D skeletal renderer and no recoloring-only hack.
Validate still frames, frame-to-frame identity, actual Android touch responsiveness, and home/shop/gameplay appearance before release.
next_character_workflow.current_starter_warning: starter-poses.js is an unapproved interim vector/face-collage test and must NOT be accepted as the final character artwork.
next_character_workflow.release_gate: Do not mark any new character complete until visually approved by user and checked against source pixels. Do not replace locked paid character originals.
